math-rush.intro: Math Rush is a fast mental-math game: you have 60 seconds to solve as many sums as you can. Questions start with simple addition and subtraction, then bring in multiplication and division as your score climbs.
howTo: Press Start and read the sum in the middle of the screen.
Tap the correct answer out of four choices, or press keys 1–4 on a keyboard.
A wrong answer costs 3 seconds, but every 5 correct answers in a row adds 3 seconds back.
features: Difficulty rises every 5 correct answers, with ×, ÷ and bigger numbers
Streak bonuses that reward accuracy over guessing
Your best score is saved in your browser

memory-pairs.intro: Memory Pairs is a classic card-matching game with 10 levels. Flip two cards at a time, remember where each fruit is hiding and clear the board in as few moves as possible — boards grow from 12 to 48 cards, and some levels race the clock.
howTo: Tap a card to flip it, then tap a second card.
If the two fruits match they stay face up; if not, they flip back over.
Find every pair to clear the level. Fewer moves earn up to 3 stars and unlock the next level.
features: 10 levels from 3×4 up to 6×8 boards, including timed levels
Star ratings and a level map that remembers your progress
Works with touch, mouse or the arrow keys

2048.intro: 2048 is the famous sliding number puzzle. Every move slides all tiles in one direction, and two tiles with the same number merge into one. Plan your moves to build the 2048 tile — then keep going for 4096.
howTo: Swipe on the board, or use the arrow keys or W A S D.
Tiles with the same number merge when they collide, and their value is added to your score.
A new 2 or 4 appears after each move. The game ends when the board is full and no merges are left.
features: Smooth sliding and merge animations
Keep playing after you reach 2048
Best score saved automatically

crossword.intro: Mini Crossword builds a brand-new puzzle every time you play, in three sizes: Easy (6 short words), Normal (8 words) and Hard (11 words on a bigger grid). Every word comes with a short, friendly English clue — a relaxing way to practise vocabulary in a few minutes.
howTo: Choose Easy, Normal or Hard, then tap a square to select it; tap it again to switch between Across and Down.
Type letters with the on-screen keyboard or your own keyboard. Use ‹ › to move between clues.
Use Check to spot mistakes or Reveal letter when you are stuck, then fill every square to solve the puzzle.
features: Endless puzzles in three difficulty levels
Simple English clues, great for learners
Best time saved for each difficulty

hangman.intro: Hangman is the classic word-guessing game. Guess the hidden English word one letter at a time before the drawing is finished. Each word comes from a topic such as animals, fruits, countries or space.
howTo: Look at the topic and count the blanks.
Tap letters on the keyboard or type them. Correct letters fill the blanks; wrong ones add a part to the drawing.
Solve the word before 6 wrong guesses. A hint reveals a letter but costs one life.
features: 120 words across 8 topics
Win streaks, with your best streak saved
A fun way to practise English spelling

brick-breaker.intro: Brick Breaker is an arcade classic: bounce the ball off your paddle to smash every brick on the screen. Each level adds more rows, tougher two-hit bricks and a faster ball.
howTo: Drag, move the mouse or use ← → to move the paddle.
Tap or press Space to launch the ball. Where it hits the paddle changes its angle.
Clear all the bricks to reach the next level. You have 3 lives.
features: Endless levels that get harder as you go
Power-ups: wide paddle and multi-ball
Best score saved on your device

gold-digger.intro: Gold Digger is a gold-mining arcade game. A claw swings back and forth above the mine — drop it at the right moment to grab gold nuggets and diamonds, and earn enough money to beat each level's target before time runs out.
howTo: Tap, press Space or ↓ to drop the claw when it points at something valuable.
Heavy items like big rocks reel in slowly. Use dynamite (🧨 or ↑) to blow up a bad catch.
Reach the money goal within 60 seconds to move on to the next level.
features: Gold, diamonds, rocks, mystery bags, running mice and TNT barrels
Endless levels with rising money goals
A shop between levels: dynamite, strength drink, lucky clover and more

blob-arena.intro: Blob Arena is an io-style eating game. You start as a tiny blob in an arena full of colourful dots and computer-controlled blobs. Eat dots and smaller blobs to grow, and avoid anything bigger than you.
howTo: Move the mouse, drag your finger or use the arrow keys to steer.
Eat dots to gain mass. You can swallow another blob once you are clearly bigger than it.
Bigger blobs move more slowly, so watch out for hunters and climb the leaderboard.
features: 16 AI opponents that chase and flee
Live leaderboard and minimap
No account needed — just open the page and play

aster-strike.intro: Aster Strike is a vertical galaxy shooter from Milaan Games. This browser demo lets you try the core gameplay: steer your ship through waves of enemies while your lasers fire automatically.
howTo: Drag with your mouse or finger to steer the ship.
Your ship fires automatically, so focus on dodging enemy bullets.
Enjoying it? Get the full game on Google Play for the 30-level campaign and boss fights.
features: Free browser demo of the mobile game
Smooth touch and mouse controls
Full version: weapon upgrades, bosses and offline play

sudoku.intro: Sudoku is the classic 9×9 logic puzzle: fill every row, column and 3×3 box with the numbers 1 to 9. Play free in your browser across four difficulty levels, from relaxed Easy grids to tough Expert ones — every puzzle is freshly generated and has exactly one solution.
howTo: Pick a difficulty and tap an empty cell.
Choose a number from the pad, or switch on Notes to pencil in candidates.
Fill the whole grid before your third mistake — up to three hints help when you get stuck.
features: Four difficulty levels, each puzzle with a unique solution
Notes, undo, erase and three hints per game
Mistake counter and best time for every level

minesweeper.intro: Minesweeper is the classic logic game of careful clicks: each number tells you how many mines touch that square. Play free in your browser on three board sizes made for phones and desktops — your first tap is always safe, so every game starts with a clean opening.
howTo: Pick a difficulty and tap any square to open the field.
Use the numbers to work out where the mines are, and flag them with a long-press, right-click or Flag mode.
Tap a number whose mines are all flagged to clear around it, and open every safe square to win.
features: Three board sizes with a safe first tap
Flag mode, long-press and quick clearing around numbers
Keyboard controls and a best time for every level

block-puzzle.intro: Block Puzzle is a relaxing yet tactical block game you can play free in your browser. Drag three pieces at a time onto an 8×8 board, fill complete rows or columns to clear them, and chain clears together for growing combo bonuses. Plan ahead — the game ends when none of your pieces fits.
howTo: Drag a piece from the tray onto the board — the preview turns green where it fits.
Fill an entire row or column to clear it; clearing several at once scores more.
Keep clearing on consecutive moves to build a combo, and leave room for the next three pieces.
features: Rows and columns clear together for multi-line bonuses
Combo multiplier and full-board clear bonus
Mouse, touch and full keyboard controls

snake.intro: Snake is the timeless arcade game, rebuilt with a cute look and smooth controls so you can play it free in your browser. Eat fruit to grow longer while the speed slowly rises, grab golden bonus fruit before it vanishes, and pick between Classic, where walls and new obstacles end your run, and Wrap, where you glide through the edges.
howTo: Choose Classic or Wrap, then press an arrow key, use WASD or swipe to start moving.
Steer toward the fruit to grow and score; golden fruit is worth five times as much but only stays a few seconds.
Avoid hitting your own tail — and in Classic, the walls and obstacles that appear every few levels.
features: Two modes with a separate best score for each
Rising speed, levels and new obstacles in Classic
Keyboard, swipe and an on-screen pad for touch

tile-match.intro: Tile Match is a cosy triple-matching puzzle you can play free in your browser. Pick fruit, sweets and animal tiles off a layered board, collect three of a kind in your tray, and plan ahead so the seven slots never fill up.
howTo: Tap any tile that isn’t covered to move it into the tray.
Collect three identical tiles in the tray to make them vanish.
Clear every tile before the 7-slot tray fills up — Undo, Shuffle and Pop can save a tricky moment.
features: Levels that grow from two easy layers to tall, tricky stacks
Every level is generated to be solvable
Earn up to three stars and pick up where you left off

four-in-a-row.intro: Four in a Row is the classic drop-the-disc strategy game, free to play online in your browser. Take turns dropping discs into a seven-column board and be the first to connect four across, up and down, or diagonally.
howTo: Choose vs Computer or 2 Players, then pick the difficulty and who moves first.
Tap a column (or use ← → and Enter, or keys 1–7) to drop your disc.
Connect four of your discs in a line before your opponent does — and block their threats.
features: Three computer levels, up to a Hard mode that searches several moves ahead
Two-player mode on one device with a running score
Track your best win streak against the Hard computer

bubble-shooter.intro: Bubble Shooter is a free bubble-popping puzzle you can play right in your browser. Aim your launcher, bank shots off the walls and connect three or more candy bubbles of the same colour to pop them — then watch everything hanging below come tumbling down for bonus points. Each level brings new shapes and more colours, and the ceiling creeps lower every time you miss.
howTo: Drag or move the pointer to aim — the dotted line shows where your bubble will bounce and land.
Release, click or press Space to shoot; tap the next bubble (or press X) to swap colours.
Match 3 or more to pop them and clear the whole board before the bubbles reach the line.
features: Aim guide with wall-bounce preview
Hand-shaped levels with more colours as you climb
Best score and highest level saved

sky-hopper.intro: Sky Hopper is a free one-tap arcade game you can play online in your browser. Tap to keep a round little bird aloft and slip through the gaps between cloud-capped towers — every tower passed is a point. The sky drifts from day to sunset to night as your score climbs, while the gaps tighten and the pace picks up, so every run is a fresh shot at a new medal.
howTo: Tap, click or press Space to hop; gravity pulls you down between taps.
Fly through the gap in each cloud tower to score a point.
Avoid the towers and the ground, then hit Play again to beat your best.
features: Bronze, silver, gold and platinum medals
Day-to-night sky that changes as you score
Fair, forgiving hitboxes and smooth controls

word-guess.intro: Word Guess is a free daily word puzzle you can play right in your browser: work out the hidden five-letter English word in six tries, using the coloured clues after each guess. Come back every day for a new word everyone shares, or switch to Unlimited and keep playing as long as you like.
howTo: Type any five-letter English word and press Enter.
Green means the right letter in the right spot; yellow means the letter is in the word but somewhere else; grey means it isn’t in the word.
Use the clues to narrow it down and solve the word within six guesses.
features: Daily word plus Unlimited mode
Streaks, win rate and guess-distribution stats
Shareable emoji results and a high-contrast colour option

tic-tac-toe.intro: Play Tic-Tac-Toe free online in your browser: the classic 3×3 game of noughts and crosses, plus Caro, where you need five in a row on a big board. Take on a computer opponent from a relaxed Easy to a tough Hard, or pass the device to a friend for a quick head-to-head.
howTo: Pick a board (Classic 3×3 or Caro), your opponent and who moves first.
Take turns placing X and O — tap a square, or use the arrow keys and Enter.
Line up three in a row (or five in Caro) before your opponent does.
features: Classic 3×3 and five-in-a-row Caro
Computer opponent with three levels, or 2 players on one device
Undo, session score and a record of wins against Hard

solitaire.intro: Solitaire is the classic Klondike card game, free to play right in your browser. Sort a shuffled deck into four foundations from Ace to King — pick relaxed Draw 1 or the trickier Draw 3, then chase your best time.
howTo: Choose Draw 1 or Draw 3 and the cards are dealt into seven columns.
Stack cards downward in alternating colors, drag them or tap a card to send it to the best spot.
Turn over the stock when you are stuck and move every card to the foundations to win.
features: Drag & drop, tap-to-move and keyboard controls
Unlimited undo, hints and auto-finish
Score, timer and best time saved for each mode

parking-escape.intro: Parking Escape is a sliding-block logic puzzle you can play free in your browser. Every car and truck can only roll forward or back, so each move has to be planned to open a lane for the red car. With 60 levels that climb from two-move warm-ups to 41-move brain-burners, it’s a satisfying test of thinking ahead.
howTo: Drag a car or truck along its lane — vehicles never turn or move sideways.
Clear a path across the third row so the red car can reach the exit on the right.
Match the optimal move count for three stars; use Undo, Restart or a Hint when you’re stuck.
features: 60 levels, each checked by a solver for its shortest solution
Hints that always show the best next move
Stars, best scores and your current board are saved

pipe-connect.intro: Pipe Connect is a relaxing plumbing puzzle you can play free in your browser. Spin straight pipes, bends and T-junctions until the water from the tap flows through the whole garden, then watch it pour along your pipes as every flower bursts into bloom.
howTo: Tap a pipe to turn it a quarter turn clockwise.
Pipes that join up with the tap fill with water straight away, so you can see what’s connected.
Fill every pipe and water all the flowers to clear the level — fewer moves earn more stars.
features: 24 levels that grow from a 4×4 grid to a busy 8×8 garden
Every level is generated from a connected pipe network, so it can always be solved
Stars for beating the target, and your progress is saved

screw-puzzle.intro: Screw Puzzle is a satisfying unscrewing game you can play free in your browser. Colourful acrylic plates are stacked on a pegboard and pinned with coloured screws — pull them out in the right order, sort them into matching boxes and watch each plate drop away.
howTo: Tap a screw that no higher plate covers to pull it out.
Screws fly into the box of their colour; others wait in the 5-slot holding tray until their box arrives.
Drop every plate before the tray fills up — Undo can rescue a bad move.
features: 30 levels that add more plates, layers and colours as you go
Every level is generated and checked to be solvable
Earn up to three stars and continue from your last level

fruit-slice.intro: Fruit Slice is a juicy arcade game you can play free in your browser: fruit flies up from the bottom of the screen and you swipe to cut it in half with a glowing blade. Slice several in one stroke for combo points, then pick Classic, where three missed fruits or a single bomb end the run, or Arcade, a frantic 60-second dash with bonus bananas.
howTo: Choose Classic or Arcade, then drag your finger or mouse across the fruit to slice it.
Cut three or more fruits in one swipe for a combo bonus — and steer clear of the bombs.
In Classic, don’t let three fruits drop; in Arcade, slice the golden, pink and blue bananas for a fruit frenzy, double points or slow motion.
features: Two modes with a separate best score for each
Hand-drawn fruit that splits in two with juice splats
Touch, mouse and keyboard controls

mole-smash.intro: Mole Smash is a quick, cheerful reflex game you can play free in your browser. Cute moles pop out of their holes faster and faster over a 60-second round — bonk them with your hammer to score, build a combo multiplier, and watch out for golden moles, helmeted moles that take two hits, and bunnies and bombs that cost you points.
howTo: Press Play and tap or click a mole as soon as it pops up — or press the key shown on its hole.
Keep hitting without a miss to raise your combo multiplier up to ×4.
Leave the bunnies and bombs alone, and hit helmeted moles twice before they duck back down.
features: Golden, helmeted and decoy critters
Rising speed and a combo multiplier
Touch, mouse, keyboard and numpad controls

sliding-puzzle.intro: Sliding Puzzle is the classic fifteen-style tile puzzle: one square is empty, and you slide the tiles around it until everything is back in order. Play free in your browser with numbers or a freshly painted picture, on three board sizes — every shuffle is guaranteed to be solvable.
howTo: Pick a board size and choose Numbers or Picture.
Tap a tile in line with the gap, swipe, or use the arrow keys to slide tiles into the empty square.
Put every tile back in order — peek at the finished board whenever you need a reminder.
features: 3×3, 4×4 and 5×5 boards, always solvable
Number tiles or a new procedural picture each game
Move counter, timer and best score for every size

nonogram.intro: Nonogram is a picture logic puzzle: the numbers beside each row and column tell you how many squares are filled, and in which groups. Play free in your browser with 56 hand-drawn pictures from 5×5 to 20×20, 12 colour puzzles, endless random grids and a new daily puzzle with a streak to keep. Every grid has exactly one solution you can reach by logic alone.
howTo: Read the clues: each number is a run of filled squares in that row or column, in order — in colour puzzles, each run is painted in its own colour.
Tap or drag to fill, and cross out empty squares with Mark mode, a long-press or right-click; pinch or use + and − to zoom into big grids.
Pick Zen for no pressure, Timed to chase a best time, or 3 lives, where every wrong fill costs a heart.
features: 56 hand-drawn pictures, 12 colour puzzles, endless random grids and a daily puzzle
Hints, undo and redo, auto-cross for finished lines and drag-to-fill
Zen, Timed and 3-lives styles, with streaks and best times saved

color-connect.intro: Color Connect is a relaxing path puzzle: draw a line between each pair of matching dots so that every square on the board is filled and no two lines cross. Play free in your browser through 75 levels on boards from 5×5 to 9×9 — every level is built around a full solution, so there is always a way to fill the grid.
howTo: Drag from a dot to draw a path to the other dot of the same colour.
Redraw any path by dragging from its dot or from the middle of the line — crossing a line cuts it.
Connect every pair and fill 100% of the board to clear the level.
features: 75 levels on 5×5 to 9×9 boards, always solvable
Hints that draw one correct path, plus undo and restart
Move counter, fill percentage and saved level progress

tower-stack.intro: Tower Stack is a free one-tap building game you can play right in your browser. A crane swings each new floor back and forth, and your timing decides whether it lands neatly, hangs over the edge or tumbles to the street. Line up perfect drops to steady the swaying tower, fill it with residents and climb from daytime to dusk, night and finally space.
howTo: Tap, click or press Space to release the floor hanging from the crane.
Land it right on top of the tower — perfect drops build combos and calm the sway.
A floor that overhangs by more than half falls off and costs one of your three lives.
features: Swaying tower physics that react to every sloppy drop
Day, dusk, night and space skies as you climb
Rooftop gardens every 10 floors and a growing resident count

stack-up.intro: Stack Up is a free isometric stacking game you can play in your browser. Slabs slide across the tower from alternating sides, and whatever overhangs when you drop is sliced away, leaving a smaller slab to stack next. Chain perfect drops to keep your width — and even win a little back — while the colours shift layer after layer.
howTo: Tap, click or press Space to drop the sliding slab onto the tower.
Any part that hangs over the edge is cut off, so the next slab gets smaller.
Line up perfect drops to keep the size; miss the tower completely and the game ends.
features: Clean isometric 2.5D look with shifting gradient colours
Perfect streaks grow your slab back slightly
Endless climb with your best score saved

knife-throw.intro: Knife Throw is a free timing game you can play online in your browser. A wooden log spins, speeds up, brakes and reverses while you throw knives into it one by one — but if your knife strikes one already stuck in the log, it bounces off and the run is over. Clear stages, slice apples for bonus points and take on a tricky boss every fifth stage.
howTo: Tap, click or press Space to throw a knife from the bottom of the screen.
Stick every knife shown on the left into the log to clear the stage.
Avoid the knives already in the log; hit apples to earn apples for new knife styles.
features: Rotation patterns that accelerate, stutter and reverse
A boss with wild motion every 5 stages: cheese, donut and orange
Collect apples to unlock five knife styles

candy-match.intro: Candy Match is a bright match-3 puzzle you can play free in your browser. Swap neighbouring sweets to make lines, build striped, wrapped and colour-bomb candies, and watch the cascades roll in as you chase each level’s goal.
howTo: Drag, swipe or tap two neighbouring candies to swap them — the swap only counts if it makes a line of three or more.
Match four for a striped candy, an L or T shape for a wrapped candy and five in a row for a colour bomb; swap two specials together for a bigger blast.
Reach the level goal — a target score, clearing every jelly or collecting certain candies — before you run out of moves.
features: 20 levels with score, jelly and collection goals
Special candies, combos and chain-reaction cascades
Earn up to three stars; your progress is saved

number-drop.intro: Number Drop is a free drop-and-merge number puzzle for your browser. Pick a column for each falling block and watch equal numbers fuse — one well-placed drop can set off a chain of merges that pulls the whole stack together.
howTo: Tap a column, or aim with ← → and press Space, to drop the next block.
Blocks with the same number that touch merge into one, doubling for every match they swallow — and the new block can merge again.
Keep every column below the top line; check the Next preview and use Swap to trade your block when you’re stuck.
features: Chain merges and combo scoring
Next-block preview and limited swaps that recharge as you grow
Smooth animations and a saved best score

fruit-merge.intro: Fruit Merge is a cosy physics puzzle you can play free in your browser. Drop fruit into the jar, let two of a kind bump together to grow into the next fruit, and plan your drops so the pile tumbles into place instead of spilling over the line.
howTo: Drag or move to aim, then release — or use ← → and Space — to drop the fruit.
When two identical fruits touch they merge into the next size up, from cherry to watermelon.
Watch the Next preview and keep the pile below the dashed line; if it stays above for two seconds, the game ends.
features: 11 hand-drawn fruits from cherry to watermelon
Smooth, stable physics with rolling and stacking
Endless play with a saved best score

water-sort.intro: Water Sort is a calm colour-sorting puzzle you can play free in your browser. Pour layers of coloured water from tube to tube until every tube holds just one colour — easy to learn, and surprisingly satisfying to plan out.
howTo: Tap a tube to pick it up, then tap the tube you want to pour into.
Water only pours onto the same colour or into an empty tube with room to spare.
Fill every tube with a single colour to finish the level — use Undo or the extra tube if you get stuck.
features: Endless levels that add more colours as you go, every one checked to be solvable
Smooth pouring animations, with symbols on each colour for colour-blind players
Your level is saved, with limited undos and one extra tube per level

ball-sort.intro: Ball Sort is a relaxing colour-sorting puzzle you can play free in your browser. Lift glossy balls out of one tube and drop them into another until every tube holds a single colour, then take on taller five-ball tubes as the levels climb.
howTo: Tap a tube to lift its top balls, then tap the tube where they should land.
Balls only land on the same colour or in an empty tube with room.
Sort every tube into one colour to clear the level — Undo and an extra tube help when you’re stuck.
features: Endless levels that grow from four-ball to five-ball tubes, each checked to be solvable
Bouncy hop animations, with a symbol on every ball for colour-blind players
Your level is saved, with limited undos and one extra tube per level

bus-sort.intro: Bus Sort is a free parking-jam puzzle you can play right in your browser. Buses are packed into a busy lot, and only the ones with a clear road ahead can drive out to the station, where passengers of the matching colour hop aboard. Pick the right bus at the right time so the bays never jam.
howTo: Tap a bus whose way out is clear to drive it to a free bay.
Passengers at the front of the queue board any parked bus of their colour, and full buses head off.
Get everyone on board before all the bays fill up with buses nobody in line can take.
features: 4-, 6- and 10-seat buses in lots that grow bigger and busier each level
Every level is checked by a solver to make sure it can be cleared
Your level is saved, with a few undos to rescue a jammed station

hoop-shot.intro: Hoop Shot is a free basketball shooting game you can play online in your browser. Flick the ball toward the rim with a slingshot drag or a quick swipe, and let real arc physics do the rest: balls rattle off the rim, kiss off the backboard and drop through the net. Sink enough and the hoop starts climbing and sliding, so every streak gets harder to keep alive.
howTo: Drag back from the ball and let go, or swipe upward; on a keyboard, aim with the arrows and hold Space to charge.
Score 2 points per basket, 3 from behind the line, plus a bonus for swishes and hot streaks.
Race the 60-second clock or keep shooting until you miss three times, and beat your best in each mode.
features: Bank shots and rim rattles with real ball physics
Moving hoop that rises and slides as you score
Separate best scores for both modes

penalty-kick.intro: Penalty Kick is a free football shootout game you can play online in your browser. Swipe the ball toward the goal and bend the path of your swipe to curl it into the corners, then swap roles and dive to keep out the computer’s kicks. Each shootout you win brings a quicker, smarter keeper, so how long can your winning streak last?
howTo: Swipe from the ball to where you want it to go and curve the swipe to bend the shot; on a keyboard, aim with the arrows and hold Space for power.
When you’re in goal, tap left, centre or right (or press ← ↓ →) to dive before the ball gets past you.
Take five kicks each, then sudden death if it’s level; win the shootout to face a sharper keeper in the next round.
features: Swipe-to-curl shots and bonus targets in every corner
Take the gloves and save shots yourself
Keeper skill rises each round; best streak saved

mini-golf.intro: Mini Golf is a free putt-putt game you can play online in your browser, with 18 hand-designed holes seen from above. Pull back to set your aim and power, then watch the ball roll, bank off angled walls, slow in the sand and ride the slopes toward the cup. Windmills, sliding gates, bumpers and water hazards keep every hole fresh, and your scorecard tracks how you stand against par.
howTo: Drag back anywhere and release; the dotted guide shows direction and power. On a keyboard, turn with the arrows and hold Space to charge.
Bank off walls, avoid sand and water (a splash costs a stroke), and time your putts past windmills and moving gates.
Sink the ball in as few strokes as you can, check the scorecard, and beat your best 18-hole total.
features: 18 hand-designed holes with windmills, slopes and bumpers
Full scorecard with par and your total
Progress and best round saved automatically

color-gate.intro: Color Gate is a free one-tap arcade game you can play online in your browser. Hop a little ball upward through spinning rings, sliding bars, crossed rotors and rotating frames — but you can only pass through the part that matches your colour. Colour orbs switch your ball along the way and the gates speed up as you collect stars, so every run is a test of timing and nerve.
howTo: Tap, click or press Space to hop; the ball falls between taps.
Pass only through segments of your own colour and grab the star inside each gate.
Touch a colour orb to switch colours, and don’t fall off the bottom of the screen.
features: Four gate types: rings, bars, rotors and frames
Gates speed up as your star count climbs
Precise, fair collisions and your best score saved

ball-maze.intro: Ball Maze is a free tilt-maze game you can play online in your browser. Roll a heavy steel ball through a wooden labyrinth to the green goal — it keeps its momentum, so you have to brake before corners. Every level is a freshly generated, larger maze, holes start appearing along the way, and a clock rewards quick, clean runs with up to three stars.
howTo: Drag anywhere to use the virtual joystick, use the arrow keys, or turn on tilt to steer with your phone.
Roll the ball to the green goal without dropping it into a hole.
Finish under the target time for three stars, then move on to a bigger maze.
features: Generated mazes that grow every level
Momentum-based ball physics and holes to avoid
Three-star timer and saved progress

bottle-flip.intro: Bottle Flip is a free skill game you can play online in your browser. Swipe up to send a half-full water bottle spinning onto the next table, shelf, stool or chair — the water sloshes and slows the spin just like the real trick, so the strength of your swipe decides everything. Land it upright to build a streak multiplier, nail perfect landings for bonus points and try the rare cap landing.
howTo: Swipe up (or hold and release Space) — a longer swipe means a higher, faster flip.
Land the bottle upright on the next piece of furniture marked by the arrow.
Chain landings to raise your multiplier; you have three bottles per run.
features: Real spin physics with shifting water weight
Perfect, double-flip and cap-landing bonuses
Streak multiplier and best score saved

checkers.intro: Checkers is the timeless board game of jumps and kings, free to play online in your browser. Slide your pieces diagonally, jump to capture, chain multi-jumps and crown your pieces as kings to outwit the computer or a friend.
howTo: Choose vs Computer or 2 Players, then pick a difficulty and your colour (Red always moves first).
Drag a piece or tap it, then tap a green dot to move; arrow keys and Enter work too.
Capture every opposing piece or leave your opponent with no legal move to win.
features: Three computer levels, up to a Hard mode that looks eight moves ahead
Forced or optional captures, multi-jump chains, undo and draw rules
Session score plus a saved count of your wins against Hard

reaction-test.intro: Reaction Test is a free online set of three quick brain-and-reflex challenges you can play right in your browser. Measure your reaction time in milliseconds, see how fast you can hit 30 targets, and find out how long a sequence you can remember.
howTo: Pick a test: Reaction Time, Aim Trainer or Sequence Memory.
Reaction Time: wait for the screen to turn green, then tap or press Space — tapping early costs a 100 ms penalty.
Finish the test to see your score on a chart of typical results, then try to beat your personal best.
features: Three tests: reaction time over 5 tries, 30-target aim trainer and sequence memory
Results compared with typical human scores on a simple chart
Personal bests saved for every test

typing-speed.intro: Typing Speed is a free online typing test you can take right in your browser. Type common English words as fast and accurately as you can and get your words per minute, raw speed and accuracy, with a chart of how your pace changed.
howTo: Pick a test: 15, 30 or 60 seconds, or 25 or 50 words — add punctuation or numbers for a tougher run.
Start typing; the timer begins with your first key. Correct letters turn dark, mistakes turn red.
When the test ends, check your WPM, accuracy and speed chart, then go for a new personal best.
features: Timed and word-count modes with optional punctuation and numbers
Live caret, WPM, raw speed, accuracy and a speed-over-time chart
Personal best saved for each mode; works with on-screen keyboards too

jumpy-climb.intro: Jumpy Climb is a free endless jumping game you can play online in your browser. Your little hand-drawn hero bounces automatically — you just steer left and right to land on the next ledge, wrapping around the edges of a hand-drawn notebook page. The higher you climb, the trickier it gets, with moving and vanishing ledges, crumbly fakes, ink monsters and swirling ink holes.
howTo: Hold the left or right side of the screen, drag, or use the arrow keys to steer.
Land on ledges to bounce higher; springs and trampolines launch you even further.
Avoid crumbling ledges, monsters and ink holes — falling off the bottom ends the run.
features: Four kinds of ledges, plus springs and trampolines
Stomp monsters from above for a free bounce
Your best height is marked right on the page

chicken-cross.intro: Chicken Cross is a free endless road-crossing game you can play online in your browser. Guide a chunky little chicken forward through traffic lanes, ride drifting logs and lily pads over rivers, and dash over railway tracks before the warning lights turn into a speeding train. Don’t dawdle, though — stand still too long and an eagle swoops down to grab you.
howTo: Tap to hop forward, or swipe and use the arrow keys to hop in any direction.
Time your hops between cars and trains, and land on logs or lily pads to cross water.
Keep moving forward — every new row is a point, and coins are a bonus.
features: Roads, rivers, lily pads and railways with warning lights
Blocky, toy-like world that gets busier as you go
Best distance and coin total saved on your device

helix-drop.intro: Helix Drop is a free 3D-style arcade game you can play online in your browser. A bouncing ball sits on a spiral of colorful rings around a central pole — spin the tower so the ball drops through the gaps, ring after ring, all the way to the finish. Red blocks end your run, but fall through three rings in a row and you become a fireball that smashes straight through anything.
howTo: Drag sideways or use the arrow keys to spin the tower.
Line up the gaps so the ball falls to the next ring; avoid landing on red blocks.
Reach the golden ring at the bottom to clear the level and move on.
features: Endless levels with more red blocks and spinning rings
Fireball mode for dropping three rings without a bounce
Your level and best score are saved

candy-rope.intro: Candy Rope is a free physics puzzle game you can play online in your browser. A sweet hangs from swinging ropes, and your job is to snip them at just the right moment so it lands in a cute monster’s mouth — grabbing up to three stars on the way. Across 24 hand-made levels you’ll meet floating bubbles, air cushions, sharp spikes, sliding anchors and pins that throw out fresh ropes.
howTo: Swipe across a rope to cut it, or press Tab to pick a rope and Enter to cut.
Tap bubbles to pop them and air cushions to puff the candy sideways.
Feed the candy to the monster, collecting stars for up to a 3-star score.
features: 24 hand-designed levels with saved star ratings
Smooth, stable rope physics
Bubbles, air cushions, spikes, moving anchors and pins

mini-pinball.intro: Mini Pinball is a free pinball game you can play online in your browser, built for portrait screens. Pull the plunger, then keep the ball alive with two snappy flippers while it ricochets off pop bumpers, slingshots and drop targets. Light all three top lanes to raise your bonus multiplier, try for the skill shot on launch, and see how high you can push your score with three balls.
howTo: Hold Space or drag the plunger down, then let go to launch the ball.
Tap the left or right half of the table (or press ← → / Z M) to flip.
Hit bumpers and targets, light the top lanes to boost your multiplier, and don’t let the ball drain.
features: Pop bumpers, slingshots, drop targets and lit lanes
Ball save at the start of every ball plus up to 5× bonus
Precise physics: flippers never let the ball slip through

star-defender.intro: Star Defender is a retro alien-formation shooter with a cute neon twist. Rows of pixel aliens march side to side, drop lower and speed up as their numbers shrink, so every wave ends in a frantic race. Play free in your browser on phone or desktop and chase a new high score.
howTo: Drag or use ← → / A D to slide your cannon along the ground.
Hold your finger down to auto-fire, or press Space; hide behind the shields when bombs rain down.
Clear every alien to start the next, faster wave — and shoot the mystery ship when it flies past.
features: Endless waves that march faster and bomb harder
Crumbling shield bunkers and a bonus mystery ship
3 lives, extra lives every 2,000 points and a saved best score

paddle-duel.intro: Paddle Duel is a quick table-tennis game built for portrait screens, with one paddle at the top and one at the bottom. The ball speeds up with every hit and its angle depends on where it meets your paddle, so rallies get wild fast. Play free in your browser against a computer opponent or a friend on the same device.
howTo: Choose vs Computer (Easy, Normal or Hard) or 2 Players on one device.
Drag to move your paddle, or use ← → (bottom) and A D (top); hit with the paddle's edge for sharper angles.
Serves alternate after every point — the first player to reach 7 points wins the match.
features: Three computer levels with human-like reactions and mistakes
Two-player mode with multi-touch, each player in their own half
Rally counter, ball trails and saved win/loss records

air-hockey.intro: Air Hockey brings the arcade table to your screen with a glowing neon rink, a slick low-friction puck and satisfying bank shots. Your mallet's speed and angle carry straight into the puck, so a quick flick sends it flying. Play free in your browser against the computer or a friend on the same device.
howTo: Pick vs Computer (Easy, Normal or Hard) or 2 Players on one device.
Drag your mallet in your half — or use the arrow keys / WASD — and strike the puck toward the opposite goal.
Guard your own goal; after each goal the puck goes to the player who conceded. First to 7 wins.
features: Real circle physics: mallet speed transfers to the puck
Multi-touch two-player mode on a single phone or tablet
Three computer levels that defend, attack and bank shots

blackjack.intro: Play Blackjack free in your browser with play chips. Go head-to-head with the dealer in 1 vs 1, or sit at a full table with four computer players who share the same 6-deck shoe. Hit, stand, double, split and surrender with real casino rules, and a built-in basic strategy coach to sharpen your play.
howTo: Tap chips to set your bet, then press Deal.
Hit to take a card or Stand to keep your total; Double, Split and Surrender appear when they are allowed.
Finish closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. A Blackjack pays 3 to 2.
features: Two modes: 1 vs 1 against the dealer or a table with four AI players
Hint button and optional strategy coach based on basic strategy
Hi-Lo card counting display, stats and accuracy tracking

crowd-rush.intro: Crowd Rush is a free crowd-runner arcade game you can play online in your browser. Your little team sprints down a track over the sea, and every gate you pick adds, multiplies, subtracts or divides your crowd — so choosing between +20 and ×2 really matters. Dodge spinning bars, saw blades, swinging hammers and edge pits, outnumber the red crowds in head-on clashes, then climb the multiplier stairs or topple the boss at the castle.
howTo: Drag anywhere on the track, or use ← → or A and D, to steer your whole crowd left and right.
Run through the gate that leaves you with the most runners, and steer around traps that knock runners out.
Arrive with a bigger crowd than every rival and boss, then climb as high as you can on the finish stairs for bonus coins.
features: 30 levels of rising difficulty, with a boss castle every fifth level
Hundreds of animated runners with gates, traps and crowd clashes
Coins, stars and upgrades for a bigger start and bonus income

hungry-hole.intro: Hungry Hole is a free arcade game you play right in your browser: you are a hole in the ground, and anything smaller than you falls in. Start by gulping down people and traffic cones, grow big enough for cars and houses, and finish by swallowing whole skyscrapers. Battle six rival holes for the top spot in a two-minute round, or clear the map in Solo to earn stars and unlock the park and the farm.
howTo: Drag anywhere on the screen to steer your hole, or use the arrow keys or WASD.
Move over anything smaller than your hole to swallow it. Every bite makes you bigger, so bigger objects soon fit too.
In Battle, finish the two minutes with the highest score; you can even swallow smaller holes. In Solo, eat as much of the map as you can to earn up to three stars.
features: Battle mode against six rival holes with a live leaderboard
Solo mode with star goals on three maps: city, park and farm
Hundreds of 3D-style objects, from walking people to towers and silos

poker.intro: Play Texas Hold’em poker free in your browser with play chips. Sit down heads-up or at a table of up to six against computer opponents with their own styles, from tight sharks to wild bluffers, and outlast them as the blinds rise. Real no-limit rules with side pots, split pots and an optional hand-odds helper make every decision count.
howTo: Choose a table size and sit down; everyone starts with 100,000 chips.
On your turn, fold, check or call, or set an amount with the slider and quick buttons and raise.
Make the best five-card hand from your two cards and the five on the board, or make everyone fold. The last player standing wins the table.
features: Heads-up or 3 to 6 player tables with rising blinds
Four computer personalities that bluff, trap and fold
Optional hand odds, stats and a best-hand record

draw-poker.intro: Play Draw Poker free in your browser with play chips: a classic Jacks or Better video poker machine and a 5-card draw table against computer opponents. Hold the right cards, chase the 4,000-credit Royal Flush and double up your wins, or sit down with up to five rivals who bluff, stand pat and fight for side pots.
howTo: Pick Video or Table at the top; you start with 100,000 play chips.
In video poker, set your bet, Deal, tap the cards to hold and Draw; the paytable shows what every hand pays.
At the table, bet, swap up to three cards (four if you keep an Ace), bet again and take the pot with the best hand.
features: 9/6 Jacks or Better paytable with double up and an auto-hold hint
2 to 6 player tables with blinds or antes, no limit or pot limit
Four computer personalities that draw, bluff and stand pat

territory-war.intro: Territory War is a fast map-conquest strategy game you can play free online in your browser. Your regions raise troops on their own; drag from one or several of them to send a marching stream at a neighbour, win the clash and watch the land turn blue. Rival armies expand, turtle up and pounce on weak spots — and they fight each other too.
howTo: Drag from your blue region (or sweep across several) to any other region and let go to send all their troops.
A region falls when its troop count drops below zero; troops meeting enemy troops on the way cancel each other out.
Wipe every rival off the map to win, and do it fast for three stars and more coins.
features: 45-level campaign plus Skirmish with 1–5 rivals and a new Daily map every day
Towers that shoot passing troops, speed bases and fast-growing capitals
Coin upgrades for starting troops, growth and march speed; full keyboard play

billiards.intro: Billiards is a free pool game you can play online in your browser, with a top-down table, real ball physics and cue-ball spin. Play 8-ball or 9-ball against a CPU opponent at three skill levels, pass the device to a friend, practise freely with ball in hand, or work through 18 trick-shot set-ups. Draw, follow and side spin behave like the real thing, so position play and bank shots really matter.
howTo: Drag on the table to aim; the guide shows the ghost ball and where both balls will go. Set spin on the cue-ball button if you want follow, draw or english.
Pull the power bar down and let go to shoot, or pull straight back from the cue ball. On a keyboard, aim with the arrows, set power with ↑ ↓ and press Space.
Follow the rules of the game you chose: claim solids or stripes and sink the 8 last, or hit the lowest ball first in 9-ball. After a foul, the other player gets ball in hand.
features: 8-ball and 9-ball vs CPU (Easy, Medium, Hard) or 2 players
Real spin physics: draw, follow and side spin off the rails
18 trick-shot challenges with stars, plus free practice

turbo-racing.intro: Turbo Racing is a free arcade racing game you can play online in your browser. Speed along sunny coasts, desert canyons, neon city streets and snowy mountain passes on a classic curvy, hilly road, then slipstream, drift and dodge to fill your nitro and blast past six rivals. Win cups to unlock new tracks, earn coins for faster cars, or see how far you can get on the endless highway before the clock runs out.
howTo: Steer with ← → or A and D, accelerate with ↑ or W and brake with ↓ or S; on a phone use the on-screen buttons, with auto-accelerate on by default.
Fill the nitro meter by drafting behind cars, drifting through sharp bends and squeezing past traffic, then hold Space, Shift or the Nitro button to boost.
Stay on the tarmac and avoid bumping other cars, finish in the top 3 of a cup to unlock the next one, and spend your coins in the garage.
features: Championship with 3 cups and 12 themed tracks against six racing rivals
Time Trial with a ghost of your best lap, plus an Endless Highway with checkpoints
Four cars to unlock and upgradeable engine, tires and nitro

high-low.intro: High Low is the classic card guessing game, free to play in your browser with play chips. Call whether the next card will be higher or lower and watch the pot climb with every right call — the buttons show the exact odds from the cards still in the deck, so every cash-out is your own decision. Try a no-chips streak through a whole deck, or take on the daily deck that everyone shuffles the same way.
howTo: In Ladder mode, tap chips to set your stake and press Deal.
Pick Higher, Lower or Same; a correct call multiplies the pot by the odds shown on the button.
Cash out whenever you like — a wrong call, or the same rank when you didn’t pick Same, loses the pot.
features: Three modes: chip Ladder, Streak through one deck and a once-a-day Daily deck
Live odds, payout multipliers and a remaining-card tracker
Options for Ace high or low and one or two decks, plus stats and best streaks

chess.intro: Chess is the classic strategy board game, free to play online in your browser. Take on the computer across ten levels, from a true beginner that still hangs pieces to an expert that calculates several moves ahead, pass the device to a friend, or sharpen your tactics with checkmate puzzles.
howTo: Pick vs Computer, 2 Players or Puzzles; against the computer, choose a level, your colour and an optional clock.
Tap a piece and then a dot, or drag it; arrow keys and Enter work too. A pawn that reaches the last rank lets you choose its promotion.
Checkmate the enemy king to win; stalemate, threefold repetition, the fifty-move rule and too little material are draws.
features: Ten computer levels from about 400 to 2200 Elo, with a ✓ or ★ for every level you beat
Full rules with castling, en passant, promotion, draws, clocks, undo, hints and resign
47 verified puzzles: mate in 1, 2 and 3 plus material-winning tactics

xiangqi.intro: Xiangqi is Chinese chess, the board game played by millions across Asia, and here you can play it free online in your browser. Cannons leap over a screen to capture, horses can be blocked at the leg and the generals must never face each other across the river, which makes every game sharp and tactical. Take on a computer opponent with eight levels, play a friend on the same device or sharpen your attack with 34 checkmate puzzles.
howTo: Pick vs Computer, 2 Players or Puzzles; Red always moves first.
Tap or drag a piece, then tap a green dot to move it — follow each piece’s rules, shown under Rules.
Checkmate the enemy general; leaving your opponent without a legal move wins too.
features: Eight computer levels, from gentle beginner to a strong searching engine
34 verified mate-in-1, 2 and 3 puzzles for Red and Black
Undo, hints, move list, board flip, resume and optional Western-style icons

falling-blocks.intro: Falling Blocks is the classic line-clearing puzzle you can play free in your browser. Rotate and slide each falling piece, complete rows to clear them, and chain combos, T-spins and back-to-back clears for big scores. Modern controls — hold, a five-piece preview, ghost piece and tunable auto-shift — make it as smooth on a keyboard as it is on a phone.
howTo: Pick a mode: Marathon (150 lines over 15 levels), Sprint (40 lines against the clock), Ultra (best score in 2 minutes) or relaxed Zen.
Move with ← →, rotate with ↑/X and Z, soft drop with ↓ and hard drop with Space — or on touch, drag to move, tap to rotate and flick down to drop.
Fill complete rows to clear them; press C (or swipe up) to hold a piece for later, and keep the stack low as the speed rises.
features: Standard rotation with wall kicks, 7-piece bag, hold and 5-piece preview
T-spin, combo, back-to-back and all-clear scoring
Adjustable DAS/ARR, swipe gestures and optional on-screen buttons

tien-len.intro: Tiến Lên is the card game Vietnam plays at every family gathering, and here you can play it free in your browser against three computer opponents. Shed all 13 cards first with singles, pairs, straights and consecutive pairs, then chop your rivals’ 2s with bombs for big points. Full southern rules, three difficulty levels and matches of 5 to 20 games keep every deal tense.
howTo: Choose the opponents’ level and the match length, then deal; whoever holds 3♠ starts the first game.
Tap or drag across cards to select them, then play a combination of the same kind and size that beats the table, or pass until the next round.
Be the first to empty your hand, chop 2s with four of a kind or consecutive pairs, and finish the match with the most points.
features: Complete southern rules: chops, frozen hands, leftover penalties and optional instant wins
Easy, Normal and Hard opponents that plan their hands and save their 2s and bombs
Hint button, one-tap combination sort, play log and saved stats

snake-arena.intro: Snake Arena is a free online snake battle you can play right in your browser. Guide your snake around a giant round arena, gobble glowing orbs to grow longer and trick rival snakes into crashing into your body — when they do, they burst into a feast of orbs. Play Endless, race the clock for first place, or outlast everyone in a shrinking arena.
howTo: Point with the mouse or drag on the screen to steer; the arrow keys turn too.
Eat orbs to grow, and hold the click, the ⚡ button or Space to boost — boosting costs a little length.
Cross in front of rivals so their heads hit your body, but never let your own head touch another snake.
features: Three modes: Endless, Timed and Last Standing with a shrinking arena
15–25 AI snakes on three levels, from relaxed grazers to ruthless hunters
12 skins to unlock, a live leaderboard and a minimap

mahjong.intro: Mahjong Solitaire is the classic tile-matching puzzle, free to play online right in your browser. Clear a stacked layout of hand-drawn mahjong tiles by pairing identical free tiles — every deal is guaranteed solvable, so it all comes down to planning which pair to take next.
howTo: Pick a layout or today’s daily puzzle; the tiles are dealt into a 3D stack.
Tap two identical free tiles to remove them — a tile is free when nothing is on top and its left or right side is open. Any two flowers or any two seasons also match.
Clear every tile to win, using hints, undo or a shuffle when you get stuck.
features: 14 layouts from 36 to 144 tiles, including the classic Turtle
Always-solvable deals, hints, unlimited undo and shuffle
Timer, stars and best times, plus a new daily puzzle

maze-muncher.intro: Maze Muncher is a classic-style maze chase you can play free in your browser. Steer your hungry muncher through five hand-built mazes, gobble every dot and grab a power pellet to freeze the four chasers so you can munch them for big points. Each chaser has its own personality, and every level gets a little faster.
howTo: Pick a difficulty and a starting maze, then press Play.
Steer with the arrow keys, WASD, a swipe or the on-screen pad, and clear every dot to finish the level.
Eat a power pellet to freeze the chasers, then catch them before they thaw — and grab the bonus fruit while it lasts.
features: Five mazes with side tunnels and rising speed
Four chasers with different hunting styles
Three difficulty levels, bonus fruit and an extra life at 10,000

bowling.intro: Bowling is a free ten-pin bowling game you can play online right in your browser. Line up your shot, add curve and release with the right speed to watch the pins scatter with real physics. Play a solo game, take on a CPU bowler from rookie to champion, pass the device around for a party of up to four, or sharpen your aim in 27 spare challenges.
howTo: Drag near the ball to set your position, then drag on the lane to aim.
Pick how much the ball curves, then hold Bowl and release when the power bar is where you want it.
Knock all ten pins down in one ball for a strike or in two for a spare, and score as much as you can over ten frames.
features: Real pin action with kickbacks, splits and a follow camera
Solo, vs CPU on three levels and 2–4 player party mode
27 spare challenges with stars, plus dry, medium and slick lanes

ludo.intro: Ludo is the classic race-and-capture board game for two to four players, free to play online in your browser. Roll the die, move your tokens around the cross-shaped board and up your home column, and land on rivals to send them back to base — luck decides the roll, but smart choices win the game.
howTo: Pick a seat for each colour — Player, CPU or Off — choose the CPU level, then press Start game.
Press Roll or Space; a 6 brings a token out of base and earns another roll. Tap a glowing token or its target square, or press 1–4.
Land exactly on the centre to bring a token home; the first player with every token home wins.
features: Up to four players in any mix of friends on one device and CPUs with three levels
Rule options: leave base on 6 or 1, safe squares, blockades, bonus rolls, 2 or 4 tokens
Step-by-step token animations, full keyboard play and your wins against the CPU saved

spider-solitaire.intro: Spider Solitaire is the classic two-deck patience game, free to play right in your browser. Stack cards down across ten columns and finish eight King-to-Ace runs in a single suit — start relaxed with one suit, then take on two or four suits once you have the knack.
howTo: Pick 1, 2 or 4 suits; 54 cards are dealt into ten columns with the rest waiting in the stock.
Drag a card, or a run of the same suit, onto a card one rank higher, or tap it to send it to the best spot.
Deal a new row when you are stuck — no column may be empty — and complete every run from King to Ace to win.
features: Winnable deals checked by a solver, or fully random ones
Unlimited undo, hints and automatic run clearing
Score, timer, saved games and stats for each mode

tower-defense.intro: Tower Defense is a classic path-defense strategy game you can play free in your browser. Place archers, cannons, frost crystals, mages and ballistas beside the road, upgrade each one three times and choose its targets as goblins, armored knights, bats, healers and bosses march on your castle. Twelve maps across meadow, desert, snow and volcano lands each award up to three stars.
howTo: Tap a free tile next to the road, then pick a tower to build it; every enemy you defeat pays gold.
Tap a tower to upgrade it, sell it or make it aim at the first, last, strongest or closest enemy.
Press Start, check the next-wave preview and call waves early for bonus gold. Keep your lives high for three stars.
features: 12 maps with single, merging and three-way roads
5 towers with 3 upgrades each and 9 enemy types, including flyers and bosses
Easy, Normal and Hard modes, 2× speed and full keyboard controls

word-search.intro: Word Search is the classic letter-grid puzzle: every word on the list is hidden somewhere in the grid, and you circle it by dragging across its letters. Play free in your browser with 26 themes, from animals and space to sweets and countries, grids from 8×8 to 15×15, and three difficulty levels that decide whether words run only across and down or hide diagonally, backwards and crossing each other. Come back every day for the daily puzzle and keep your streak going.
howTo: Pick a theme, a grid size and a difficulty, or open today’s daily puzzle.
Drag across a word in any of the 8 directions, or tap its first and then its last letter. The keyboard works too: arrow keys, then Enter on the first and last letter.
Find every word on the list. A hint flashes the first letter of a word but adds 15 seconds, so fewer hints earn more stars.
features: 26 themes with 30+ English words each, and fresh grids every game
Easy, Normal and Hard: from across-and-down words to all 8 directions, backwards and crossing
Daily puzzle with streaks, a Time Attack mode, best times and progress that saves

sea-battle.intro: Sea Battle is the classic naval guessing game, free to play online in your browser. Deploy your fleet in secret, then trade shots with the computer and sink every enemy ship before it finds yours. Three AI levels, from random fire to a probability-hunting admiral, keep every match tense.
howTo: Drag your ships onto the grid, tap one to rotate it, or press Random — then hit Ready.
Tap a square in enemy waters to fire; in Salvo mode pick one target for every ship you still have afloat.
Read the hits and misses to track down each ship, and sink the whole enemy fleet first.
features: Classic and Salvo modes, plus a 10-ship fleet where ships may not touch
Easy, Normal and Hard AI that never peeks at your fleet
Stats per difficulty with your fewest-shots record

archery.intro: Archery is a free target archery game you can play online right in your browser. Pull back the bow, steady your sight against a gently swaying hold, read the wind flags and watch your arrow arc downrange into the rings. Fight through a five-round knockout tournament against CPU archers, pop balloons and shoot apples in 24 challenges, or see how long you last in Endless as the range, wind and moving targets get tougher.
howTo: Drag down on the range to draw the bow, then move your finger or mouse to aim.
Check the wind indicator and flags, hold off into the wind and release to shoot.
Score up to 10 per arrow in sets of three; the small inner gold ring counts as X.
features: Knockout tournament from 18 m to 90 m with Olympic-style set scoring and shoot-offs
24 challenges with balloons, apples, swinging targets and a scarecrow to avoid
Real wind drift, gravity arcs, sight pins and moving targets in Endless mode

reversi.intro: Reversi is the timeless disc-flipping strategy game: place a disc so it traps a line of your opponent’s discs, flip them all to your colour and own the most squares when the board fills up. Play free in your browser against a computer that ranges from a relaxed beginner to a grandmaster that solves the endgame perfectly, or pass the device to a friend.
howTo: Tap a glowing square to place a disc that sandwiches at least one line of opposing discs.
Every trapped disc flips to your colour; if you have no legal move, your turn is passed.
When neither side can move, the player with more discs wins.
features: Eight computer levels plus 2-player mode on one device
6×6, 8×8 and 10×10 boards with legal-move markers
Unlimited undo, hints, move list and saved games

box-push.intro: Box Push is a classic warehouse puzzle you can play free in your browser: walk the worker around and shove every crate onto a glowing target. Crates can be pushed but never pulled, so one careless shove into a corner can trap a crate for good. Sixty original levels climb from four-push warm-ups to five-crate expert rooms that need real planning.
howTo: Walk with the arrow keys or WASD, tap a square to walk there, or swipe on the board.
Walk into a crate to push it one square; get every crate onto a target to clear the level.
Match the optimal push count for three stars — use Undo, Restart or a Hint whenever a crate gets stuck.
features: 60 original levels, each checked by a solver for its fewest pushes
Hints that always show the best next push
Stars, best scores and your unfinished level are saved

hexa-sort.intro: Hexa Sort is a relaxing colour-sorting puzzle you can play free online, right in your browser. Drop stacks of hex tiles onto the board and watch matching colours flip from stack to stack until ten of a kind pop away in a satisfying chain reaction.
howTo: Drag a stack from the tray onto any free cell, or tap a stack and then a cell.
Neighbouring stacks with the same top colour merge; a run of 10 or more tiles of one colour clears.
Reach the level goal before the board fills up, using the hammer, swap and shuffle boosters when you get stuck.
features: 40 levels with tile and colour goals, locked cells and new board shapes
Hammer, swap and shuffle boosters plus stars for efficient solves
Endless mode, colour-blind symbols and progress saved automatically

jigsaw.intro: Jigsaw Puzzle is a relaxing classic you can play free online, right in your browser. Pick one of 24 hand-painted pictures — mountains, harbours, coral reefs, city lights and bold patterns — cut it into 12 to 150 knob-shaped pieces and rebuild it on a roomy wooden table.
howTo: Choose a picture and how many pieces you want; switch on rotating pieces for an extra challenge.
Drag pieces onto the board or onto each other — matching neighbours click together and move as one group.
Use the faint preview, the edge-pieces filter and zoom to finish the picture; your progress is saved automatically.
features: 24 illustrated pictures cut into 12, 24, 48, 70, 108 or 150 pieces
Snapping groups, optional rotation, edge filter, preview and zoom
Auto-saved progress, best times and a gallery of finished pictures

darts.intro: Darts puts a regulation dartboard in your browser, with the right number order, doubles, trebles and bull. Hold to steady your hand, time the release and play 501 or 301 with checkout suggestions, Cricket or Around the Clock — free against the CPU or a friend on the same device.
howTo: Pick a mode, then choose a CPU level, a friend or solo practice.
Press and hold on the board: the aim circle calms as your hand steadies, so release at the right moment.
In 501 count down to exactly zero and finish on a double; in Cricket close 15–20 and the bull first.
features: 501/301 with double-out, busts and checkout tips
Cricket and Around the Clock
3 CPU levels, 2 players and match stats

marble-chain.intro: Marble Chain is a free marble-shooting puzzle you can play online in your browser. A chain of coloured marbles rolls along a winding track toward a hole, and your shooter in the middle fires marbles into it — match three or more of a colour to pop them, close the gaps for chain-reaction combos and keep the chain from reaching the end.
howTo: Aim with the mouse or your finger and release to shoot a marble into the chain.
Make groups of 3 or more of the same colour; when the gap closes on matching colours, a combo pops more.
Tap the shooter or press X to swap marbles, and clear the whole chain before it rolls into the hole.
features: 24 levels with different curved tracks, including twin chains
Slow, reverse, bomb and laser-aim power-ups
Endless mode with a speeding chain and stars for every track

fishing.intro: Fishing Frenzy is a free casual fishing game you can play right in your browser. Sink your hook through five ocean zones, from sunny shallows to the pitch-black abyss, dodging fish on the way down and catching everything you can on the way back up. Spend your coins on a longer line, a faster rod and a bigger hook, and fill your fish book with 30 species.
howTo: Tap or press Space to cast, then steer the hook by dragging, with the mouse or with the arrow keys.
On the way down, avoid the fish to sink deeper; on the way up, steer into them and keep clear of jellyfish and junk.
Tap the fish as they leap out of the water for bonus coins, then buy upgrades to reach deeper, richer waters.
features: Five ocean zones and 30 species to collect, including rare finds
Upgrades for the line, rod, hook and a jellyfish guard
Harbor orders and a daily bonus that grows with your streak

o-an-quan.intro: Ô Ăn Quan is the traditional Vietnamese stone game children have drawn on school yards for generations, now free to play online in your browser. Sow your stones around the board, chain captures across empty squares and race to grab the two big mandarin stones. A classic Mancala (Kalah) mode is included too, against the computer or a friend.
howTo: Tap one of your squares that holds stones, then pick a direction with the arrows.
Stones are dropped one by one; keep sowing from a full square, or capture the square beyond an empty one.
When both mandarins are gone, the stones on your row are added to your pile — the higher total wins.
features: Authentic rules: chain captures, refilling an empty row, young mandarin option
Mancala (Kalah) mode with extra turns and captures
Computer opponent with 3 levels, or 2 players on one device

hearts.intro: Play Hearts free in your browser against three computer opponents. Pass three cards each hand, follow suit and slip your dangerous cards onto someone else — or take every heart and the queen of spades to shoot the moon. The lowest score when someone reaches 100 (or 50) wins.
howTo: Pick three cards to pass to the left, right or across; every fourth hand you keep your cards.
Follow the suit that was led; when you can't, throw away high hearts or the Q♠.
Each heart costs 1 point and the Q♠ costs 13 — keep your score lowest until someone hits the target.
features: Three opponent levels, from relaxed to card-counting experts
Shoot the moon with +26 to others or your choice of −26
Hints, last-trick review, played-card tracker and scoreboard

castle-smash.intro: Castle Smash is a free slingshot physics game you can play online in your browser. Pull back, launch and watch wooden huts, glass towers and stone keeps wobble and crash down on the cartoon goblins hiding inside. With 36 levels across three worlds and special shots that split, smash and explode, every castle is a new little puzzle.
howTo: Drag back from the slingshot to aim; the dotted line shows the start of the arc.
Let go to launch, and tap while a Splitter or Bomb is flying to use its power.
Knock out every goblin before you run out of shots; fewer shots earn more stars.
features: Real block physics with wood, glass and stone that crack and break
36 levels in three worlds with Splitter, Boulder and Bomb shots
Three stars per level, saved progress and touch, mouse or keyboard controls

burger-shop.intro: Burger Shop is a cheerful time-management cooking game you can play free in your browser. Customers line up with tickets showing exactly how their burger is stacked; grill the patties without burning them, build each burger in the right order, add fries and sodas, and serve fast for bigger tips. Earn coins across 30 days in three restaurants, spend them on upgrades, then test your speed in the endless rush.
howTo: Tap a bun to start a burger on the selected plate, drop patties on the grill and add each cooked patty and topping in the order shown on the ticket.
Tap a finished burger, fries or soda to serve it to the customer who ordered it, or drag it to them; the faster you serve, the bigger the tip.
Reach the day’s coin goal to unlock the next day, then buy a faster grill, extra plates, a turbo fryer or a soda fountain in the upgrade shop.
features: 30 days with new ingredients, food critics and three restaurants
7 upgrades plus an endless rush mode with a best score
Tap, drag or full keyboard shortcuts on phone and desktop

freecell.intro: FreeCell is the classic open-deck solitaire where every card is face up from the start, so skill — not luck — decides the game. Play it free in your browser: pick a numbered deal, take on today’s daily deal, or let a solver-checked random deal test your planning.
howTo: Build the eight columns down in alternating colors, and park single cards in the four free cells when you need room.
Drag a card or a run onto another column, or tap it to send it to the best spot — free cells and empty columns let you move longer runs at once.
Move all 52 cards to the four foundations, Ace to King by suit, to win the deal.
features: 32,000 numbered deals checked by our own solver, plus a daily deal
Hints from a built-in solver, unlimited undo and safe auto-moves
Stats, winning streaks and saved games

dots-boxes.intro: Dots and Boxes is the classic pencil-and-paper strategy game, free to play online in your browser. Take turns drawing lines between dots; whoever draws the fourth side of a box claims it and moves again, so every line can set up a chain reaction.
howTo: Pick vs Computer or 2 Players, a board from 3×3 to 7×7 and who moves first.
Tap or click between two dots (or use the arrow keys and Enter) to draw a line.
Close a box to claim it and draw again — avoid giving your opponent a box’s third side. Most boxes wins.
features: Four computer levels, up to an Expert that plays the long-chain rule and double-deals
Five board sizes, two-player mode on one device and undo against the computer
Line preview, last-move highlight and your record and win streak per level

pixel-jumper.intro: Pixel Jumper is a free side-scrolling platformer you can play right in your browser. Dash across grassy hills, crystal caves, icy peaks and a lava castle, collect coins, hunt down three hidden gems per level and face a boss at the end of every world.
howTo: Run with ← → (or A D, or the on-screen arrows) and jump with Space, ↑ or the jump button — hold it longer to jump higher.
Land on enemies to stomp them, but steer clear of spikes, lava and spiky critters. Touch a checkpoint flag so a slip only sends you back a little.
Reach the goal flag to clear the level, and find all 3 gems for a 3-star rating.
features: 24 hand-built levels in 4 worlds, including 3 boss fights and an avalanche chase
Moving platforms, springs, crumbling blocks, slippery ice and leaping fireballs
Unlimited retries with a timer, best times and gem stars saved on your device

color-claim.intro: Color Claim is a free territory-grabbing arcade game you can play online in your browser. Slip out of your base, draw a loop across the grid and head home — everything inside turns your color. But while you are outside, your trail is your weak spot: if a rival touches it you are out, and if you cross theirs first, they are.
howTo: Steer your block with swipes, the on-screen joystick, the mouse, or the arrow keys and WASD.
Leave your land to draw a trail, then return to your own color to claim every cell you enclosed.
Keep your loops short when rivals are near, and cut their trails or surround their land to knock them out.
features: Three modes: endless Classic, 3-minute Timed and last-one-standing Battle on a shrinking map
6 to 12 computer rivals with their own styles — cautious, greedy, raiders and trail hunters
Live leaderboard by share of the map, a minimap and personal bests

kakuro.intro: Kakuro is a cross-sum logic puzzle: fill the white squares with the digits 1 to 9 so that every across and down run adds up to the clue beside it, without repeating a digit in a run. Play free in your browser with fresh grids from 6×6 to 12×12 in four difficulties, plus a daily puzzle with a streak to keep. Every grid is checked to have exactly one solution, so pure logic always gets you there.
howTo: Read the clues: the number above a down run or left of an across run is the total its digits must reach, with no digit used twice.
Tap a white square and pick a digit; the combination helper lists every set of digits that can make each of its two runs.
Use notes, undo and up to three hints per puzzle, and turn on Show mistakes if you want wrong digits marked.
features: Grids from 6×6 to 12×12 in four difficulties, each with one unique solution
Pencil marks, a combination helper, hints, undo and a timer
Daily puzzle with streaks, best times and auto-saved progress

zombie-survival.intro: Zombie Survival is a free top-down wave shooter you can play online in your browser. Hole up in a house, a supermarket or a barn, shoot goofy cartoon zombies through the boarded-up windows and spend your coins on shotguns, rifles and upgrades between waves. Hold out for 15 waves and the rescue chopper arrives — or keep fighting for a high score.
howTo: Move with WASD or the left thumb stick; aim with the mouse or the right stick, or switch on auto-aim.
Shoot the zombies before they break the barricades, and hold E or Repair to board the windows back up.
Between waves, spend your coins in the shop on new guns, ammo, armor and upgrades.
features: Pistol, shotgun, SMG, rifle and grenades with ammo and reloads
Runners, tanks, spitters and a Zombie King boss every 5 waves
Three maps, three difficulties, touch twin-stick or keyboard and mouse

math-rush.intro: Math Rush là game tính nhẩm tốc độ: bạn có 60 giây để giải càng nhiều phép tính càng tốt. Câu hỏi bắt đầu với phép cộng, trừ đơn giản, rồi xuất hiện thêm phép nhân và chia khi điểm số của bạn tăng lên. Chơi online miễn phí ngay trên trình duyệt.
howTo: Nhấn Bắt đầu và đọc phép tính ở giữa màn hình.
Chạm vào đáp án đúng trong bốn lựa chọn, hoặc nhấn phím 1–4 trên bàn phím.
Trả lời sai bị trừ 3 giây, nhưng cứ 5 câu đúng liên tiếp bạn sẽ được cộng lại 3 giây.
features: Độ khó tăng sau mỗi 5 câu đúng, với ×, ÷ và các số lớn hơn
Thưởng chuỗi trả lời đúng, khuyến khích sự chính xác thay vì đoán mò
Điểm cao nhất được lưu ngay trên trình duyệt của bạn

memory-pairs.intro: Memory Pairs là game lật thẻ tìm cặp kinh điển với 10 màn chơi. Mỗi lượt bạn lật hai thẻ, ghi nhớ vị trí của từng loại trái cây và dọn sạch bàn chơi với ít lượt nhất có thể — bàn chơi tăng dần từ 12 lên 48 thẻ, và một số màn còn tính giờ.
howTo: Chạm vào một thẻ để lật, sau đó chạm vào thẻ thứ hai.
Nếu hai loại trái cây giống nhau, chúng sẽ được giữ ngửa; nếu không, chúng sẽ úp lại.
Tìm hết các cặp để qua màn và mở khóa màn tiếp theo. Càng ít lượt, bạn càng nhận được nhiều sao (tối đa 3 sao).
features: 10 màn chơi với bàn từ 3×4 đến 6×8, có cả màn tính giờ
Đánh giá bằng sao và bản đồ màn chơi lưu lại tiến trình của bạn
Chơi bằng cảm ứng, chuột hoặc phím mũi tên

2048.intro: 2048 là game giải đố trượt số nổi tiếng. Mỗi lần di chuyển, tất cả các ô sẽ trượt về cùng một hướng, và hai ô có cùng số sẽ gộp lại thành một. Hãy tính toán nước đi để tạo ra ô 2048 — rồi tiếp tục chinh phục 4096. Chơi 2048 online miễn phí, không cần tải về.
howTo: Vuốt trên bàn chơi, hoặc dùng phím mũi tên hay W A S D.
Các ô có cùng số sẽ gộp lại khi chạm nhau, và giá trị của chúng được cộng vào điểm của bạn.
Sau mỗi lượt, một ô 2 hoặc 4 mới sẽ xuất hiện. Trò chơi kết thúc khi bàn chơi đã đầy và không còn ô nào gộp được.
features: Hiệu ứng trượt và gộp ô mượt mà
Tiếp tục chơi sau khi đạt 2048
Tự động lưu điểm cao nhất

crossword.intro: Mini Crossword tạo ra một ô chữ hoàn toàn mới mỗi lần bạn chơi, với ba mức độ: Dễ (6 từ ngắn), Thường (8 từ) và Khó (11 từ trên lưới lớn hơn). Mỗi từ đi kèm một gợi ý tiếng Anh ngắn, dễ hiểu — cách thư giãn để luyện từ vựng chỉ trong vài phút.
howTo: Chọn Dễ, Thường hoặc Khó, rồi chạm vào một ô để chọn; chạm lần nữa để chuyển giữa Ngang và Dọc.
Gõ chữ cái bằng bàn phím trên màn hình hoặc bàn phím của bạn. Dùng ‹ › để chuyển giữa các gợi ý.
Dùng Kiểm tra để tìm lỗi sai hoặc Mở 1 chữ khi bị bí, rồi điền kín mọi ô để giải xong ô chữ.
features: Ô chữ mới không giới hạn với ba mức độ khó
Gợi ý bằng tiếng Anh đơn giản, rất phù hợp cho người học
Lưu thời gian tốt nhất cho từng mức độ

hangman.intro: Hangman (người treo cổ) là trò chơi đoán chữ kinh điển. Hãy đoán từ tiếng Anh bị ẩn, từng chữ cái một, trước khi hình vẽ hoàn thành. Mỗi từ thuộc một chủ đề như động vật, trái cây, quốc gia hay vũ trụ.
howTo: Xem chủ đề và đếm số ô trống.
Chạm vào chữ cái trên bàn phím hoặc gõ trực tiếp. Chữ đúng sẽ được điền vào ô trống; chữ sai sẽ thêm một phần vào hình vẽ.
Giải được từ trước khi đoán sai 6 lần. Dùng gợi ý sẽ mở một chữ cái nhưng mất một mạng.
features: 120 từ thuộc 8 chủ đề
Tính chuỗi thắng liên tiếp và lưu lại chuỗi dài nhất của bạn
Cách vui để luyện chính tả tiếng Anh

brick-breaker.intro: Brick Breaker là game phá gạch arcade kinh điển: đỡ bóng bằng thanh trượt để đập vỡ mọi viên gạch trên màn hình. Mỗi màn chơi lại có thêm nhiều hàng gạch, gạch cứng phải đập hai lần mới vỡ và bóng bay nhanh hơn.
howTo: Kéo, di chuột hoặc dùng ← → để di chuyển thanh trượt.
Chạm hoặc nhấn Space để phóng bóng. Vị trí bóng chạm vào thanh trượt sẽ quyết định góc bay.
Phá hết gạch để qua màn tiếp theo. Bạn có 3 mạng.
features: Màn chơi vô tận, càng chơi càng khó
Vật phẩm hỗ trợ: thanh trượt dài và nhân bóng
Điểm cao nhất được lưu trên thiết bị của bạn

gold-digger.intro: Gold Digger là game đào vàng phong cách arcade. Một chiếc móc đung đưa qua lại phía trên mỏ — hãy thả móc đúng lúc để gắp vàng và kim cương, kiếm đủ tiền đạt mục tiêu của mỗi màn trước khi hết giờ.
howTo: Chạm, nhấn Space hoặc ↓ để thả móc khi nó chĩa vào món đồ có giá trị.
Vật nặng như tảng đá lớn sẽ được kéo lên rất chậm. Dùng thuốc nổ (🧨 hoặc ↑) để phá bỏ món đồ gắp nhầm.
Đạt mục tiêu tiền trong 60 giây để qua màn tiếp theo.
features: Vàng, kim cương, đá, túi bí ẩn, chuột chạy và thùng TNT
Màn chơi vô tận với mục tiêu tiền ngày càng cao
Cửa hàng giữa các màn: thuốc nổ, nước tăng lực, cỏ bốn lá và nhiều món khác

blob-arena.intro: Blob Arena là game ăn chấm phong cách io. Bạn bắt đầu là một khối blob nhỏ xíu trong đấu trường đầy những chấm màu sắc và các blob do máy điều khiển. Ăn chấm và các blob nhỏ hơn để lớn lên, đồng thời tránh xa mọi thứ to hơn bạn.
howTo: Di chuột, kéo ngón tay hoặc dùng phím mũi tên để điều khiển.
